description:
Sitar for Cortisol Reset | Indian Instrumental Music | 1.5 Hours

Some stress doesn't leave when the day does.

The work is over. The week is done. But the body is still running — still holding the tension it built up over five days of decisions, pressure, and staying switched on. You can't force it to stop. You can't think your way out of cortisol. You just need something to sit with while it gradually releases.

This is 90 minutes of Sitar in Raga Kedar — an evening raga with a distinctive oscillating quality unlike any other. Kedar alternates between its natural and raised fourth, creating phrases that feel like they're gently loosening something. Not pulling, just easing. Light tabla underneath — enough rhythm to keep the music present and alive, not enough to feel like anything is being demanded of you.

Press play. Sit with it. The body will follow.

🎵 What you'll hear:
- Sitar — warm plucked tones, characteristic meend glides and gamak ornamentation
- Raga Kedar — distinctive oscillating quality, grounding and devotional
- Light tabla — very low dynamic, steady pulse, present but never demanding
- Soft tanpura drone underneath
- 90 unbroken minutes at 432Hz
- Subtle alpha wave layer barely audible underneath

⏱ Chapters
0:00    Still running
20:00   Beginning to settle
45:00   The body releasing
70:00   Quiet
85:00   Reset

🧠 How to use:
You don't need to do anything. Press play and let it be on. The Sitar handles the reset. By the time you notice the tension is leaving, it will already have been leaving for a while.

⏱ Best for:
• End-of-week body tension and cortisol buildup
• Sunday evening reset before the new week starts
• Stress that lives in the body, not just the mind
• Background for winding down after a long day
• Nervous system downregulation after high-pressure days

📺 Subscribe to Raga Focus for daily Indian classical music for anxiety, sleep, and mental calm.
